_comment: Fields of the config of build-bundle.sh. A key that starts with _ is ignored. Paths are absolute. A field marked (optional) may be left out. Replace each <...> before use, and delete each key whose value starts with ( and says it is optional.
out_root: (optional) where kernel-bundle-<C>, kernel-freeze-<name>-<C> and kernel-soak-<C>-... go. Default: <repo>/work/synth-kaggle
check_root: (optional) where the checks write check-<C> and ramp59-<C>. Default: the scratchpad path that the base scripts hold
sp: (optional) the SP line of common.sh, where nb-test.sh finds comp/arc-agi_test_challenges.json
base_bundle: <path of the last bundle, kernel-bundle-<BASEC>: its scratch/ is copied and adapted, its manifest.json and dataset/ are the base>
prev_soak: (optional) default: kernel-soak-<BASEC>-linux-ramp59-2400s beside the base bundle. It must hold soak-read.json, rss-peak.out, dag-read.json, peak-read.out, cpu.txt, manifest.json and run.sh
head_before: <commit prefix that HEAD of the worktree has before the merge, or null>

merge._comment: mode: merge (ref, expected_tree, resolutions), files (from, paths, message, expected_tree) or none. resolutions maps a conflict path to {file, blob}: the resolved text and its git blob hash. With a conflict that no resolution covers the script stops and leaves the merge in progress.
merge.ref: <commit to merge, never a moving name>
merge.expected_tree: <tree of the merge commit, or leave out>

worker_settings_message: (optional) the commit message of the settings change
expected_head: <commit prefix of HEAD after steps 2, or leave out>
expected_tree: <tree of HEAD after step 2, or leave out>

freeze._comment: name gives kernel-freeze-<name>-<C>. template is a freeze folder or manifest.json whose fields are copied; manifest overrides them. reuse (a folder) skips the copy.
freeze.name: <name>

reference_bundle: (optional) a finished bundle whose dataset/ this build must equal (code.bin by members)

code_vs_kit.kit: (optional) the tested kit folder, if it changes
code_vs_kit.differ: (optional) the whole list under model/study/, in place of the base's

scratch._comment: add_files maps a path under scratch/ to a file to copy in; remove lists paths; edits are {file, old, new, count (default 1)} text replacements, applied after the derived substitutions.

notes: (optional) the bundle manifest's notes, such as a lexical read named

wheel_engine: (needed where the wheel changes) {commit, includes, engine_source, ...}
wheels_seconds: (needed where the wheel changes) how the wheels were built
arclog_tests: (optional) the result of the arclog tests; the default says not run, with the base's entry

code_notes.kaggle_worker: (optional) text for code.<file>; @sha:kaggle_worker.py@ gives the file's 12-hex hash

check_reads.code-read: (optional) the read text of a quick check
